title: Liverpool sign Barcelona defender Ronald Araujo on season-long loan with permanent option
dek: Liverpool completed the signing of Barcelona defender Ronald Araujo on a season-long loan with an option to make the move permanent for approximately 55 million euros next summer. Araujo wore the No. 33 shirt and will cover a pay cut to facilitate the move as he seeks to revive his career after losing favor at Barcelona.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Ronald Araujo, 27, signed on a season-long loan from Barcelona with an option for Liverpool to make the move permanent next summer for around 55 million euros.
bottom_line: Araujo's arrival provides immediate depth for a depleted back line heading into the new season, while the loan structure allows Liverpool to assess his form and fitness before committing to a permanent deal. His previous two seasons at Barcelona raise questions about whether the loan can restore his career form.
body: Liverpool completed the signing of Barcelona defender Ronald Araujo on a season-long loan with an option to make the move permanent next summer for approximately 55 million euros. Araujo will wear the No. 33 shirt and took a pay cut to facilitate the deal, with Liverpool covering his wages for the duration of the campaign.

Araujo, 27, arrives at Anfield after losing his place at Barcelona over the past two years. He was limited to just 16 starts in all competitions last season, with Pau Cubarsi, Eric Garcia, and Gerard Martin preferred ahead of him, according to ESPN. His decline followed the arrival of coach Hansi Flick in 2024, compounded by form issues, injuries, and mental health challenges. A hamstring injury ruled him out for four months at the start of the 2024-25 campaign, and he took two months out last season after suffering from anxiety and depression for over a year.

The move comes as Liverpool's new head coach Andoni Iraola addresses significant defensive depth problems. Joe Gomez, Giovanni Leoni, and Jeremy Jacquet are working their way back from injury, and the club lost center-back Ibrahima Konate on a free transfer to Real Madrid at the end of the previous term. Araujo can operate at center-back and right-back, a versatility that addresses Liverpool's current shortage at right-back with Conor Bradley sidelined.

Araujo made 213 first-team appearances for Barcelona after joining from Uruguayan side Boston River in 2018. He played a key role in Barcelona's LaLiga title win in 2022-23 under Xavi Hernandez alongside Andreas Christensen. He has earned 27 caps for Uruguay and was part of Marcelo Bielsa's squad at this summer's World Cup, though he did not appear in any matches.

Araujo stated upon signing: "I think it was the ideal move for me at this stage in my career. I think it was a move that was necessary for me to take. As soon as I heard that interest from Liverpool, everything went into action really, really quickly."

The reporting does not clarify whether the 55 million euro permanent option constitutes a firm obligation or remains strictly discretionary for Liverpool, nor does it detail performance-based conditions or automatic conversion triggers.
